description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three different knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, measured by a ratio in percentage. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, while the vertical axis represents the ratio (%) ranging from 50 to 90. For each domain, three bars represent the respective model's performance: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 achieve high ratios, both exceeding 90%, with Llama3 slightly higher, while ChatGPT scores around 73%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 again leads with a ratio just above 90%, followed by Llama3 at approximately 85%, and ChatGPT at about 64%. In the Basketball category, Llama3 scores around 68%, Qwen2 is the lowest at approximately 58%, and ChatGPT is around 62%. The chart shows that Qwen2 performs best in Movies and Songs, while Llama3 performs best in Basketball, and ChatGPT consistently shows lower performance in all categories.
